newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: San Miguel B up 2.77 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: San Miguel B up 2.77 pct in late trade.

text.p: San Miguel B shares gained 3 pesos, or 2.77 percent, to 111 pesos a share in late trade on investor positioning, brokers said.
"There's positioning for next year and some investors believe in the recovery of the beverage sector this last quarter," said Norman Cruz, trader at Philipine Asia Equity Securities Inc.
San Miguel A shares rose by one peso to 54 late in the session.

The bad news for the company in terms of lower sales had ended after the third quarter and it was now poised for better times with increased spending coming from the Christmas season as well as a higher gross national product growth, brokers said.

"The third quarter is seen as the last bad quarter for San Miguel and with the good Gross National Product figures, the issue is seen reaching 59.50 to 60 pesos," said Joey Roxas, president at Eagle Securities.
A total of 1.18 million San Miguel B shares and 747,930 A shares changed hands in late trade.
